items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: Well, I'll tell you how George was. He was a, to me he was a sweet clarinet player.

ctx.x: Did the Walter Barnes live here or did he just come in on gigs? No, no. He stayed up there in Natchez.
How about Bacay? What were some of the things you liked about the way Bacay played? Peter Bacay? No, George Bacay. What? Bacay. Bacay. Oh, George? Yeah.

Well, I'll tell you how George was. He was a, to me he was a sweet clarinet player. You know, he just took his time and made that. You know, he didn't rough it out. But he had that one way. Now for a band man, he wasn't that much, he ain't a band man. But he was a tough man in the parade. And you could hear him way down there but so sweet.
